provenance.paper_title: What Memory Do GUI Agents Really Need? From Passive Records to Active Task-Driving States

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Task values are continually linked to their workflow role and current use status to drive action selection.

A learned but fixed deployed mechanism continually updates value roles and workflow status. For ATMem, this specifically supports a trained but frozen update module of active task-driving execution state.
The active state replaces outdated or already-used workflow values. For ATMem, this specifically supports fixed-rule correction of stored state of active task-driving execution state.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): STR-GRPO updates the memory mechanism during training only; inference uses the trained updater to modify state under a fixed policy, so this is T2. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
